analysis_steps.goal: Make Stokes I, Q, U images

method.value: tclean with Briggs weighting after phase-only self-calibration

evidence.quote: All images were generated with Briggs weighting.

analysis_steps.goal: Derive debiased PI, PF and polarization angles

method.value: PI=sqrt(Q^2+U^2-sigma^2); PF=PI/I; PA=0.5 arctan(U/Q), above 3 sigma_PI

evidence.quote: We therefore debiased the PI image as ${\rm PI}=\sqrt{Q^2+U^2-\sigma_{\rm PI}^2}$

method.value: Images made with same uv range, 0.87 mm smoothed to match beam; compute Delta PA and PF ratios

evidence.quote: the images of the polarization vector differences (Supplementary Figure 1) were generated using the same uv distance.

method.value: Chi-square fit of angular offset between observed B (polarization rotated 90 deg) and toroidal field vs position angle at 200+-50 au in the south

evidence.quote: We find that $|B_r |:|B_\phi |:|B_z | = 0.26:1:0.23$ best fits the observations from the chi-squared fit as shown in Figure 3.

assumptions.value: inclination 27 deg, PA 161 deg; same p_max in both layers for dual model

evidence.quote: assuming the disk inclination and position angle of 27$^\circ$ and 161$^\circ$, respectively
We find that $|B_r |:|B_\phi |:|B_z |  = 0.26:1:0.23$ best fits the observations from the chi-squared fit as shown in Figure 3.

validation.value: Compared with alternate ratio parameters; reduced chi2 ~9 (single) vs ~16 (dual)

evidence.quote: The reduced chi-square value for the best-fit model is approximately 16, which is larger than that of the single layer model.

analysis_steps.goal: Estimate eta_A, B strength, Am, beta, alpha, power-law index

method.value: Balance of B_phi generation by vertical shear and ambipolar dissipation; eta_A=B^2/(4 pi C gamma rho^1.5); flux argument B_r/B_z=1/(p+2)

evidence.quote: By assuming the balance between the generation of $B_\phi$ by vertical shear motion and the dissipation of $B_\phi$ by ambipolar diffusion, $B_\phi$ can be estimated

assumptions.value: M*=2.4 Msun, T=30 K, Sigma_g=0.2 g cm-2, zeta_CR=1e-17 s-1, HCO+ dominant ion, H_dust~H_gas, r~200 au, H~20 au

evidence.quote: By applying the central star of $2.4$ $M_\odot$, temperature of $30$ K, and $\frac{B_z}{B_\phi}$ of 0.23

validation.value: Compared with MRI boundary, simulations and Zeeman upper limit

evidence.quote: the magnetic field strength of $0.3$ mG at $\sim 200$ au from the central star is consistent with a prediction from numerical simulations
in CASA 6.5.1 for all projects expect 2022.1.00406.S

(9 for the single layer model and 16 for the dual layer model)
a magnetic field strength of $B \sim 0.3$ milli Gauss (mG)
the ambipolar Elsasser number Am of $\sim 0.4$
the plasma beta of $\beta \sim 2.0\times10^2$

findings_qualitative.value: Southern polarization is consistent across wavelengths and attributed to magnetically aligned grains in a toroidal field

evidence.quote: we conclude that at least the smaller dust grains in the southern region are magnetically aligned

claims.hypothesis: Southern polarization arises from magnetic grain alignment rather than self-scattering
claims.experiment: Compared polarization vectors and fractions at four wavelengths
claims.result: Delta PA ~0 and fraction ratios ~1 in south; ~90 deg flips in north

evidence.quote: suggest that the polarization is produced by grain alignment rather than self-scattering

claims.hypothesis: 3D field components can be derived from offset from toroidal
claims.experiment: Chi-square fit of single and dual layer models

evidence.quote: The reduced chi-square value for the best-fit model is approximately 9

claims.hypothesis: Field strength and activity can be inferred
claims.finding: MRI may operate near the boundary

evidence.quote: we suggest that the magnetorotational instability (MRI) can occur in the southern region of HD 142527

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Dual layer model disfavored (higher reduced chi-square, Bphi would drop at midplane)

evidence.quote: the single layer model can reproduce the observed features of the systematic offset and variation along the position angle better than the dual layer model

limitations_admitted.value: Reduced chi-square much greater than 1; more detailed observations and refined models needed

evidence.quote: more detailed observations and refined models would be necessary to understand fine magnetic structure

referee_caveats_inferred: Reduced chi2 of 9-16 with no parameter uncertainties
Field strength relies on many assumed quantities (T, Sigma, ionization, ion species)
Field sign ambiguity; only absolute values used
Single-region analysis; 0.87 mm optical depth assumed
